recentItems.title: LIVE | 6th Summit of the Crimea Platform: Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s address
recentItems.description:
On 23 September in New York, during the high-level segment of the UN General Assembly, the 6th Summit of the Crimea Platform is taking place. The event brings together Ukraine’s international partners at the highest political level, with the participation of Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. The focus of the participants is on the situation in the temporarily occupied Crimea, systematic human rights violations, and the militarization of the peninsula. The main goal of the meeting remains the coordination of joint steps toward the full deoccupation of the Crimean Peninsula.

recentItems.title: SHADOW FLEET’S DEADLY SEA: “Magyar’s Birds” Trap Russians in the Sea of Azov
recentItems.description:
Ukraine’s Unmanned Systems Forces attacked around 300 tankers from Russia’s shadow fleet, effectively blocking the Kerch Strait and the Sea of Azov. Repeated strikes on the Kuibyshev oil refinery also disabled the key AVT-4 and AVT-5 processing units. Meanwhile, four FSB facilities were hit in the Kherson region.

In response, Russian forces attacked Kyiv with jet-powered drones, damaging a business center and a gas station.

On the international stage, following talks with Donald Trump, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that the United States was ready to issue a license for the production of Patriot missiles in Ukraine. At the same time, Japan agreed to provide air-defense systems for the winter, Poland is preparing bases for 15,000 U.S. troops, and India is reducing its purchases of Russian oil.

recentItems.title: “DO NOT LET PUTIN USE YOUR PEOPLE FOR HIS SHAME!”: Zelenskyy’s address at the UN to 47 countries!
recentItems.description:
At the UN General Assembly, Volodymyr Zelenskyy called Putin “patient zero,” revealing the catastrophic cost of the war for Russia: 248,964 occupiers lost in eight months of 2026 — 248 lives for every square kilometer seized. Amid Armed Forces of Ukraine strikes, even Donald Trump acknowledged the collapse of Russian oil refining.

Despite massive air terror using ballistic missiles and jet-powered Shaheds, Ukraine has tested four types of its own high-speed interceptors and, together with 10 partners, launched the FREYJA counter-missile program.

The President warned the Kremlin: if Russia strikes our energy infrastructure, “General Winter” will strike Russia itself. He also called on the leaders of 47 states to stop the recruitment of their citizens to be slaughtered for the sake of Moscow’s ambitions.
